blocks.text: The programme’s main motorcycle is the Triumph Big Trail Tiger 900, with rental for 10 days. Luggage travels separately, and a support vehicle is available for participants who prefer to cover part of the route without riding. The longest scheduled riding stages are around 350–360 km a day, so the route combines full days on the road with days off the motorcycle in Paraty, Rio and Capitólio. These stops allow time for boat trips, city tours and rest between riding stages.
